CINEMATIC CITY WORLD

StarLife

An actual playable anime-style life sandbox: explore the city, walk to places, meet people, date, study, work, buy property and cars, travel, raise a family, handle health and crime, and grow old. The illustrated scenes are real in-game backgrounds used behind the live character, NPCs, movement, interactions, and life systems—not a poster or slideshow.

Desktop: WASD / arrows to walk • Phone/iPad: drag anywhere to move • Tap buildings/NPCs • Type natural-language commands
